text: Morning all (I know it's arvo lol)
Morning love. I've been up since 5 so it's still morning for me
Arvo here. Been on a roof since 6
Can someone cover Pip thu? I've got a client in the city at 8
I can do Thu. Is it the usual 7:30 at the oval end
Yep. He'll pull toward the bins, just let him, it's fine
Wed I'm off the walks. Job in Subiaco. Anyone free? Rocky's the big staffy, needs a proper walk not the quick loop
I can take Rocky wed if no one else. I'm off wed arvo anyway
Legend. His lead's in the blue bag at the gate, not the car
Did you notice Luna's been limping a bit? Saw her Fri, favouring the back left
No? She was fine sat. I'll check her paw wed when I get her
If it's still on wed I'll take her to the vet thu, Dr Ho on the corner of Angelo st
Shelter's got a new litter of kittens in, not dogs but thought you'd want to know. Also the foster family for the beagle came through, can you let Tahlia know the cage is free
Will do. Ta

[photo: a timber gate hinge that's rusted through]
anyone know a dog friendly fence guy? This bloke's gate keeps getting nosed open
Dunno. Try the park Facebook group
Can't believe it's 30 Nov already xmas is basically here
Hate that. Last year I was still doing a deck in Dec
Fri still open? Biscuit's the little one who sits on people
Fri I can do after 2, shelter's got a volunteer thing till then
Fri I'll take Biscuit. He's no trouble, I'll be on the bench with him
